_notes: Universal card-extraction template. Every card (credit, debit, prepaid; any issuer) fills this same shape. Use null for 'not yet verified / unknown', use the string "N/A" for 'this field genuinely does not apply to this card' (e.g. cash_advance on a debit card, invite_only fields on an open-application card), and use [] for 'verified — this card has none of these'. Never delete a key because it doesn't apply — mark it N/A so downstream ingestion can tell 'not applicable' apart from 'not scraped yet'.

dynamic_currency_conversion_dcc.trigger_condition: SOC: markup up to 3.5% on foreign currency, dynamic and static conversion transactions; also on rupee transactions at an international location or at India-located merchants registered overseas (MITC: 3.5% on all cards except Nova, Insignia, iGlobe, World Xclusive, World Safari family and Lumiere)

category_surcharges.trigger_condition: 1% fee on all rental transactions, no cap stated (SOC, MITC)
1% fee on each fuel and auto transaction above INR 10,000, at most INR 3,000 per transaction; the amount includes the surcharge (MITC)
1% fee on aggregate utility spend above INR 50,000 in a month per card (SOC, MITC)
1% fee on education payments made through third-party apps such as Cred, PhonePe, Paytm, Mobikwik, Freecharge; payments on the school or college website or its POS carry no fee (SOC, MITC)
1% fee on FASTag loading and toll payments above INR 10,000 per transaction per card (SOC, MITC)

reward_redemption_fee.notes: Cashback card with no points to redeem (page: "No points. Just Cashback."); cashback is credited to the card account. The MITC INR 99 + GST redemption fee applies to reward points, so it does not apply here.

components: Total GST + current month EMI debits
Higher of (100% of fees and charges + 5% of retail spends, cash advance and interest) or INR 200
Previously unpaid minimum amount due, if any
If this sum exceeds the total amount due, the minimum due equals the total amount due

annual_fee_waiver.evaluation_condition: Annual fee of INR 1,499 (plus GST) for the next membership year is waived when eligible retail spend in the membership year is INR 4,00,000 or more (T&C 3.6, page, MITC). Fuel and auto, utilities, insurance, quasi-cash, railways, rent, education, wallet, government, contracted services, cash, miscellaneous, Bills2Pay, EMI conversions, fees, charges and GST do not count.

welcome_and_renewal_gift.condition: One-time INR 250 cashback for a card purchase within 30 days of issuance and payment of the annual membership fee by the payment due date; credited within 2 weeks of purchase settlement; debited again if net spend within the 30 days falls to nil; paid accounts only (T&C 3.1).

lifestyle_and_network_benefits.label: Weekend movie ticket offer: INR 200 discount or one free ticket, whichever is lower, once a month

value.rule: 12.5% of the outstanding amount (statement total amount due less net payments), minimum INR 5, maximum INR 1,300, plus 18% GST; levied only when the account stays past due for more than 3 days after the payment due date
value.source: MITC RBL-CC-MITC-V2-29-10-2026 section A.v (effective 17 Oct 2025); SOC RBL-CC-SOC-V2-04-06-2026
value.note: A percentage fee cannot be expressed as fixed slabs, so late_payment_slabs is empty.

value.rule: 1.5% of the amount or INR 150, whichever is higher, on EMI conversions done at the merchant outlet, website or app; plus 18% GST
value.note: emi_charges has no percentage field, so merchant_instant_emi_processing_fee_inr is null. Post-purchase EMI and foreclosure charges are not stated in the MITC text read.

value.rule: Up to 3.99% per month (47.88% a year). MITC bands by CIBIL score: above 775 = 3.35% a month, 725 to 775 = 3.85%, below 725 = 3.99%. Interest-free period up to 50 days, not available if the previous balance was not paid in full or cash was withdrawn.
value.source: MITC section A.iv and A.iii.c; SOC
value.note: The draft stores the 3.99% maximum. The band a given cardholder gets is not published per card.

value.research_method: issuer pages read in a real browser session or issuer PDFs read with pdftotext; no model summaries used as facts

sources.kind: issuer product page (cashback, welcome, BookMyShow, fuel surcharge, fees tab, excluded-MCC table)
Schedule of Charges, footer RBL-CC-SOC-V2-04-06-2026 (4 Jun 2026): membership fee, finance charge, late fee, cash advance, forex markup, redemption fee, 1% category fees
MITC cum KFS, footer RBL-CC-MITC-V2-29-10-2026 (29 Oct 2026): per-card fee and waiver, add-on fee, grace period, minimum due, late fee, interest bands
Cardmember Agreement, footer RBL-CC-CMA-27-10-2026 (27 Oct 2026): points reversal 12.9, 24-month points expiry 12.19, primary-only redemption 12.21
RBL current credit card list ("Showing 64 Cards"): product is on the list, with "Know more" only unless stated otherwise per card
RBL network availability guide: which networks each card is issued on
Duet Plus T&C (6 pages; no printed date, PDF created 18 Dec 2025): 3.1 welcome, 3.2 cashback, 3.3 BookMyShow, 3.5 fuel, 3.6 fee waiver, 3.7 MCC table
Co-brand partner roles document (PDF created 15 Aug 2025): Paisabazaar markets and solicits applications; KYC is done by RBL
RBL BookMyShow offers guide (PDF created 6 Jan 2026): "Paisabazaar Duet Plus: buy 1 get 1, up to Rs. 200, Saturday and Sunday, once a month"

open_questions: Annual fee waiver: the SOC (4 Jun 2026) shows INR 1,499 for both years with no waiver marker, while the issuer page, T&C 3.6 and the MITC (29 Oct 2026) all state the waiver on INR 4 lakh spend in the previous membership year. The three newer sources are used.

The "Travel and Dining" MCC list (T&C 3.7) holds only commuter transport 4111, airlines (4511 and the 3000-series), airports 4582 and restaurants and fast food (5812, 5814). Hotels and travel agencies are not in it although the page says "all travel and dining transactions".
Contracted services appear in the excluded-MCC table on the page and in T&C 3.7 but not in the category list of T&C 3.2; treated as excluded.
The INR 500 combined monthly maximum is stated on the page only; the T&C states the two sub-caps (INR 200 and INR 300). Both are modelled, with the INR 500 total as parent.
Cap period is the calendar month (page and T&C), while the fee tables use the billing cycle; modelled as calendar_month.

Whether new applications are open: RBL lists the card with "Know more" only, but the partner roles document says Paisabazaar solicits applications. application_mode set to open on that basis; confirm.
The Xpress Cash instant-loan facility has its own terms (https://webassets.rbl.bank.in/pdfs/Emailer/terms-xpress-cash.pdf) which were not read; not modelled.
Interest: the SOC and MITC give "up to 3.99% a month" and score bands (3.35%, 3.85%, 3.99%); no per-card rate is published, so the 3.99% maximum is stored.

The per-card T&C carries no printed revision date. PDF creation dates are quoted in the sources list; the SOC (4 Jun 2026), MITC (29 Oct 2026) and Cardmember Agreement (27 Oct 2026) carry footer reference codes with dates.

Joining fee: the MITC says "Joining Fee NIL" and charges the first-year membership fee after the first debit transaction. joining_fee_inr here repeats the SOC "Annual Fee (1st Year)" so the first-year cost is visible, the same convention as the Shoppers Stop overlay.
notes: Cashback card: no points. Network is Mastercard only (RBL network guide and issuer page).
Cashback is credited within 2 weeks of settlement; the minimum eligible transaction is INR 100; amounts are rounded down (T&C 3.2).

Fuel surcharge reversal: 1% up to INR 100 a month on fuel purchases between INR 500 and INR 4,000 (excluding the surcharge); purchases of INR 499 or less pay a INR 10 surcharge, purchases of INR 4,001 or more pay 1% with no reversal; GST is not reversed (T&C 3.5).

Weekend BookMyShow offer: INR 200 off or one free ticket (whichever is lower) on Saturday and Sunday shows, once a month, primary card only; the free ticket requires paying in full for at least one other ticket (T&C 3.3).
